newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian forex market closed for Christmas.
newsitem.headline: Indian forex market closed for Christmas.

text.p: There were no foreign exchange transactions on Wednesday as banks in India were closed for Christmas, dealers said.
Foreign exchange trading will resume on Thursday.
On Tuesday, poor dollar demand had pushed the Indian rupee up to close at 35.80/81 from the day's opening 35.825/835.
The rupee traded at a high of 35.80 and a low of 35.83 in thin trade, dealers said.
They said the premia on six-month dollars ended Tuesday at 7.82 percent annualised against Monday's close of 7.76 percent.
